name: pontocoleta
description: PontoColeta — encontre e cadastre pontos de coleta de materiais especiais em Londrina.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:mobile
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:backend
